audit.why: Poppy is a melee engage support with no ranged poke; Lux's E-Q zones her off the wave early and her R (140/120/100s) is a channel — the level chart's Lux-favoured read through lane is consistent with the kit even though the sample winrate (47.85%, 1281 games) is near 50/50.

Spikes at Lvl 2 (Q punishes Heroic Charge step-ups), Lvl 6 (instant R from range), 1st item (Luden's compounds poke), and late (range out-values her short-range disruption) are already well-stated and grounded in real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three matchup-defining interactions from missingInteractions were absent from the page: Poppy's R (Keeper's Verdict) is an interruptible channel that Lux's Q cancels outright; Poppy can go untargetable during the R channel to dodge a timed R burst; and her passive shield (Iron Ambassador) absorbs burst and must be baited out before an all-in.
audit.why: These are the highest-value, kit-specific facts for this matchup and were missing from tldr, dosFull, and breakdown.cooldowns, which instead carried templated language.
